title: Goan Pork Vindaloo

ingredients.name: 1 kilo boneless pork (pick a slightly fatty cut)
1-2 tbsp oil (olive or sunflower; check label)
Vinegar, to grind to a paste

tasks.title: Cut pork, blend spice paste and chop onions
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Cut pork into even pieces. Blend the spices with vinegar; chop the onions.

tasks.title: Cook the vindaloo until the pork is tender
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Soften onions, fry the spice paste, then coat the pork. Add water and simmer covered; check liquid and tenderness. Cool promptly in shallow containers and refrigerate.

tasks.title: Reheat vindaloo
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Same-day preparation.
tasks.guidance: Reheat until 165°F throughout, stirring and adding a splash of water if needed. Keep hot at 140°F or above until serving.

title: Chicken Cafreal

ingredients.name: loosely packed cilantro/coriander leaves with  tender stalks, (about 30 stalks)
6-7  green chillies, (adjust as per desired heat)
A small ball of tamarind/Juice of half a lime

tasks.title: Prepare chicken and blend cafreal paste
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Score chicken and season with lemon, ginger, garlic and salt. Blend the green paste. Coat chicken with half; keep the unused paste separately covered in the fridge.

tasks.title: Refrigerate chicken in its marinade
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Leave covered in the fridge for at least 2–3 hours, or overnight. Keep reserved paste separate from raw chicken.

tasks.title: Sear chicken, then cook in cafreal paste
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Same-day preparation.
tasks.guidance: Brown both sides in butter and oil. Add reserved paste and a little water; cover and cook, then uncover to reduce the sauce. Check the thickest pieces are cooked through. Keep hot at 140°F or above until serving; check with a thermometer.

title: The Ultimate Goan Caldin Curry

ingredients.name: Water (1cup for first grind, 1 cup for the 2nd grind, ½ to swirl in the jar)
3-4 tbsp Oil (olive or sunflower; check label)
½ (1 cup) Medium Red Onion, finely diced
½ (½ cup) Medium Tomato, skinned and finely chopped

tasks.title: Blend coconut extract and cook the caldin base
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Same-day preparation.
tasks.guidance: Grind spices, ginger, garlic, chilli and coconut with water; strain, then extract a second time. Soften onion and tomato. Add the extract, tamarind and seasoning; simmer gently.

tasks.title: Season fish and finish the caldin
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Same-day preparation.
tasks.guidance: Season fish with salt and turmeric. Gently cook it in the simmering curry; add chilli and coconut cream toward the end. Stop when the fish is opaque and flakes easily. Keep hot at 140°F or above until serving.

title: Goan Sannas (yeast method)

ingredients.name: Oil for molds (olive or sunflower; check label)

tasks.title: Rinse rice and cover with water
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Rinse parboiled rice and cover generously with water for the overnight soak.

tasks.title: Soak rice overnight
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Leave the rice soaking overnight; drain before grinding.

tasks.title: Grind rice and coconut; mix in yeast and sugar
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Same-day preparation.
tasks.guidance: Drain rice. Grind rice and coconut finely with enough coconut water for a thick batter, then stir in yeast and sugar.

tasks.title: Let batter rise until bubbly
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Same-day preparation.
tasks.guidance: Allow about 3 hours in a warm spot. Continue when visibly risen and bubbly; use the batter once ready.

tasks.title: Fill molds, steam and unmold sannas
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Same-day preparation.
tasks.guidance: Fold salt into risen batter. Half-fill greased molds and steam until set; the source gives 12–15 minutes. Let them firm briefly before unmolding. Refrigerate promptly after cooling; re-steam before serving.

tasks.title: Re-steam sannas before serving
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Same-day preparation.
tasks.guidance: Steam chilled sannas until hot throughout. Keep covered and hot until serving.

source_text: Xantilicious yeast sannas: source yield 18–20 pieces. Soak rice overnight, grind with coconut, add yeast and sugar, ferment about 3 hours until risen, salt, fill greased molds halfway and steam 12–15 minutes. Estimated serving basis: two pieces per person.

title: The Best Doce

ingredients.name: (300 grams) Chana Dal / Bengal Gram / Split Chickpeas

tasks.title: Rinse chana dal and cover with water
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Rinse the dal thoroughly and cover with plenty of water.

tasks.title: Soak chana dal
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Soak for 5–6 hours or overnight, then drain.

tasks.title: Cook dal until soft; cool and blend with coconut
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Pressure-cook dal until soft using your cooker instructions; let pressure release before opening. Drain and reserve the liquid. Cool enough for your blender, then blend dal and coconut separately using minimal reserved liquid.

tasks.title: Stir the doce until thick, then shape and cut
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Stir dal, coconut and sugar continuously as it thickens. Add cardamom and ghee. When it forms a nonsticky dough, spread on a greased surface, mark a pattern, cool briefly and cut.

tasks.title: Let doce cool fully
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Leave pieces to cool before separating and packing. For this ahead-of-time plan, refrigerate in a covered container once cool.

title: Christmas Fruit Cake (without nuts or alcohol)

ingredients.name: caster sugar, you may use soft brown/muscovado too

tasks.title: Chop dried fruit and add orange juice
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Chop the dried fruit, mix with orange juice and mixed spice, and cover.

tasks.title: Soak fruit for 6–8 hours or overnight
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Leave covered until the fruit has absorbed the juice.

tasks.title: Mix fruit cake batter and bake
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Line the tin and preheat to 120°C. Mix butter, sugar, eggs and remaining ingredients; fold in fruit with its juice ; omit almonds and walnuts. Bake 2½–3 hours, checking for browning after 1½ hours. A skewer should come out clean.

tasks.title: Cool cake in the tin
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Let the cake settle in its tin before unmolding.

tasks.title: Move cake to a cooling rack
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Carefully unmold the cake and leave uncovered on a rack until completely cool.

tasks.title: Let cake cool completely
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Wait until completely cool before wrapping; allow longer if still warm.

tasks.title: Wrap the cooled fruit cake
tasks.evidence: Publisher method; task minutes and check-in placement are planning estimates. Make-ahead allowance is a planning estimate; follow storage notes.
tasks.guidance: Wrap the completely cooled cake airtight. This nonalcoholic cake is planned within three days of serving.
